MeshCore admin intro: Configure the MeshCore serial companion connection and decide which message streams should be stored in ioBroker.
MeshCore admin alpha warning: Alpha only: this adapter is running as a test build, but it is still rough, vibe-coded, and not human-reviewed.
Serial permission hint: If the adapter cannot open the port, make sure the ioBroker user is in the dialout group and that the device permissions inside your host, container, or VM are correct.
Serial device help: Choose the MeshCore USB serial device. A stable path under /dev/serial/by-id is usually safer than /dev/ttyACM0.
Store public channel messages help: If enabled, public channel traffic is written into the adapter object tree.
Additional channel subscriptions help: Add extra channels as a text list by channel index or exact channel name. Separate entries with commas, semicolons, or new lines. Public is always monitored separately.
Sync device time on connect help: Updates the MeshCore companion clock whenever the adapter connects successfully.
Fallback message poll interval in second: Fallback message poll interval in seconds
Extra polling interval for waiting messages if no push event arrives. Set to 0 to disable polling.
Metadata refresh interval in minutes hel: How often the adapter refreshes contacts, channels, and stats after startup. Set to 0 to disable periodic refresh.
Reconnect delay in seconds help: Delay before the next reconnect attempt after a disconnect or connection error.
Stored messages per branch help: Maximum number of messages kept in each public, channel, or private history branch.
Overview section intro: Live overview from the running adapter instance. Use this area to inspect connection details, identity data, QR export, and the currently known channels on the MeshCore device.
Overview static hint: Dynamic live widgets are disabled here because they are not rendered reliably by this ioBroker admin setup. Read the current values in the object tree under meta.self, meta.device, meta.stats.*, meta.channels, and info.*. After changing channels or subscriptions, reload this admin page with F5 to pick up the latest state.
Channel management intro: Create or update a MeshCore channel directly on the connected device. To store traffic from that channel in ioBroker, also add the channel index or exact name to the subscription list above.
Channel list static hint: The current channel list is stored in the object tree under meta.channels. This settings page does not render the live list inline anymore. After creating or changing a channel, reload this page with F5 and check meta.channels if you need the updated device view.
Channel index for create or update: Channel index for create or update
Channel index for create or update help: Use an index greater than 0. Public remains channel 0.
Channel name for create or update: Channel name for create or update
Channel name for create or update help: Exact channel name to write to the MeshCore device.
Channel secret for create or update: Channel secret for create or update
Channel secret for create or update help: Optional hexadecimal secret. Leave it empty to let the adapter generate a random secret.
Save channel to device help: Writes the specified channel definition to the connected MeshCore device.
